name: Holiday Fluffy Mashed Idaho Russet Potatoes with Melted Butter & Sea Salt
whyItWorks: Peeled Idaho russet potatoes boiled until fork-tender and whipped smooth with melted butter, light milk, and sea salt. Zero skins, zero roughage, and high in potassium.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Enjoy warm whipped mashed potatoes; top with clear turkey broth or light gravy.
watchOuts: Ensure potatoes are peeled with zero skins remaining
